g.text: Muzzle flash flipbook source for a Unity particle system: 6-frame
sequence (ignition, peak, decay, smoke wisps) on black background,
side view, additive-friendly white-yellow core with brass-orange
fringe, 512x512 per frame on a 1536x2048 sheet (3x2), crisp edges,
no camera motion. For assembly into a Unity particle/flipbook
material in a later Unity task.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
